subject: Status Screen
text: The status screen displays the character's name, level, condition, HP, MP, Attack Power, Defense Power, gold, experience, Stamina, Power, Wisdom, and Will.

evidence.quote:
Hero - The name of your character.
L - The current level of your character.
Good - The current condition of your character.
HP - The current hit points / the total hit points.
MP - The current magic points/ the total magic points.
AP - Your character's Attack Power.
DP - Your character's Defense Power.
GP - The amount of your characters gold.
E - The characters Experience acquired / Experience needed to Level Up.
Stamina - The amount of Stamina your character has.
Power - The amount of Power your character has.
Wisdom - The amount of Wisdom your character has.
Will - The amount of Will your character has.

subject: Save File
text: Final Fantasy Adventure features 2 save slots and allows saving 1 game per slot.

evidence.quote:
The game Final Fantasy Adventure has 2 Slots. You can only save 1 Game
for every slot.

subject: Continue
text: A saved game can only be loaded by selecting the continue option on the main menu.

evidence.quote:
You can only load a game by accessing the continue option during the
main menu.

subject: Soft Reset
text: Pressing the A, B, Select, and Start buttons simultaneously resets the game without saving.

evidence.quote:
To reset the game you must press the A, B, Select, and Start buttons at
the same time.

subject: Hero
text: The character moves across the screen using the directional pad.

evidence.quote: You move your character around with the directional pad.

subject: Overworld Terrain
text: Meadows, marshes, deserts, mountain vines, snowfields, the Desert of Crystal, the Field of Floating Rocks, and log bridges can be traveled over.

evidence.quote: Meadows - A region covered with low grass...Bridges - Log bridges that cross over rivers

subject: Obstacle Removal
text: Forest trees can be cut down using an Axe, marsh vines can be cut with Sickles, and floating rocks can be smashed with a Morning Star.

evidence.quote:
Forests - Trees that can be cut by an Axe.
   Marshes - Vines that can be cut by Sickles
   Floating Rocks - Rocks that can be smashed by the Morning Star

subject: Dungeon Doors
text: Dungeon doors can be passed through to open them, though certain doors require Keys.

evidence.quote: Door - Can be opened by walking through, but some need Keys.

subject: Dungeon Hazards
text: Touching spikes, lava, or barriers inflicts damage on the Hero.

evidence.quote: Spikes/Lave/Barriers - When touched deal damage to Hero.

subject: Dungeon Obstacles
text: In dungeons, ferns can be cut with a Sickle, thorns with an Axe, and rocks or pots smashed with a Mattock or Morning Star.

evidence.quote:
Ferns - Can be cut with a Sickle
   Thorns - Can be cut with an Axe
   Rocks - Can be smashed with a Mattock or Morning Star
   Pots - Can be smashed with a Mattock or Morning Star

subject: Weapon Attack
text: Pressing the A button attacks enemies in weapon range, dealing damage until the enemy's HP reaches 0.

evidence.quote:
To attack enemies,
move your character so that the enemy is in range of your weapon. Then
press the A button. Every time you successfully hit the enemy he will
receive damage. Once his HP's reach 0, he will die.

subject: Magic Attack
text: Equipping one of six types of attack magic and pressing the B button unleashes a spell that travels straight or can be manipulated using the Directional Pad.

evidence.quote:
There are six types of magic that can be used for attacking. To use
magic on an enemy you must have the magic equipped. Then, press the B
button. Some types of magic only fly in straight lines, while others
will require you to manipulate the magic using the Directional Pad.

subject: Attack Items
text: There are eight different types of items used for attacking like magic, though each item has a limited number of uses.

evidence.quote:
There are eight different types of Items that can be used for attacking
the enemy. Item attacks are used the same way as magic attacks and have
the same general effect as a magic spell would. However, the damage
dealt might be different, and unlike magic, Items have a limited number
of uses.

subject: Shield
text: Touching a monster causes damage unless the Hero avoids it or blocks with an equipped, appropriate shield while at a higher level than that monster.

evidence.quote:
If you touch a monster, you will receive damage at once. The
only way to prevent damage is to either to avoid the monster, or touch
him with your Shield. Your Shield will only work if it is equipped, you
have the appropriate type of shield, and your level is higher than that
monster.

subject: Will Meter
text: When equipped with a weapon, the Will Meter increases to its maximum to enable a unique attack shared across all weapons of that type.

evidence.quote:
When you are equipped with a weapon, your Will Meter (found at the
bottom of the screen), will increase until it is at its maximum. When
it reaches its max, your weapon will attack in a unique way. The same
weapon types will have the same unique attack.

subject: Swords
text: At max Will, holding the A button executes a movable Spin Attack, while pressing the A button and Directional Pad executes a Charge Attack.

evidence.quote:
Swords         Spin Attack - Press and hold the A button. This will
               make your character spin with his sword. While
               spinning you can move him with the directional pad.

               Charge Attack - Press the A Button and the Directional
               pad. Your character will charge in the direction you
               pushed the Directional pad in.

subject: Axes
text: At max Will, an Axe is thrown in the direction the character is facing.

evidence.quote: Axes           It will be thrown in the direction you're facing.

subject: Sickle
text: At max Will, the Sickle extends longer than normal.

evidence.quote: Sickle         The Sickle will extend longer than normal

subject: Chains
text: At max Will, the Chain extends longer than normal.

evidence.quote: Chains         The Chain will extend longer than normal

subject: Spears
text: At max Will, a Spear is thrown in the direction the character is facing.

evidence.quote: Spears         The Spear will be thrown in the direction you're facing.

subject: Morning Star
text: At max Will, the Morning Star extends longer than normal.

evidence.quote: Morning Star   The Morning Star will extend longer than normal.

subject: Consumables
text: Items have limited uses and can restore HP/MP, cure status ailments, sell for gold, open doors, or establish new routes.

evidence.quote:
The different types of items in
the game are, items that recover your HP/MP, cure your status, sold for
money, open doors and create new routes, and items that can affect your
status. Items can only be used a certain number of times

subject: Leveling Up
text: Defeating a monster awards Experience and Gold, and reaching the required Experience gains a level which fully restores HP and MP.

evidence.quote:
Every time you defeat a monster you will gain Experience and Gold.
After gaining a certain amount of Experience you will gain a level. A
message will appear on the screen telling you that your character
leveled up, and that your HP/MP has also been restored.

subject: Stat Growth
text: When leveling up, choosing a stat to boost acts as the primary stat increase while potentially boosting another stat to a lesser degree.

evidence.quote:
Now a new
screen will appear. It asks you to choose what type of stat you want to
boost...The stat you choose will be the primary stat that will be boosted, some
stats will also boost a different stat, but to a lesser degree.

subject: Terrain
text: Terrain that your character cannot travel over includes Forests, Bushes, Rock-Walls, Oasis's, Oceans, Rivers, and Lakes.

evidence.quote: Terrain that your character CANNOT travel over...*Forests - A region covered with trees...Bushes - A region covered with large leafy plants...Rock-Walls - The walls of mountains...Oasis's - Fountains of water found in the desert...Oceans - Large bodies of water around different continents...Rivers - Small stretches of water crossing the land...Lakes - Small bodies of water surrounded by land
